note: Where Claude Code on a fleet mini sends its requests: ~/.claude/settings.json env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL is one of routes, with a placeholder ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN (the gateway ignores it and injects a pooled account). A provisioned mini never holds a personal login or CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN: it expires, and it bills one person (cmuxterm-hq knowledge/setup-mac-mini Step 8). glaeda-mini-health checks the route with a real `claude -p` every probe_every_s, reroutes to the first route that answers when it fails, and reports a claude_route finding while none does; cmuxterm-hq build-fleet/capture-host admits no capture lease on a mini with that finding. Seen 2026-10-21: cmux-mac-mini's personal login had expired, and the subrouter pool on :31415 hung every request from cmux11s and cmux7s, while sr2-gateway answered.

claude_code.note: Where glaeda-mini-health's claude_missing heal installs Claude Code on a fleet mini that has none: the channel's version, its platform binary kept only when the version's manifest.json sha256 matches (as Anthropic's install.sh does), then `claude install VERSION`. Claude Code updates itself afterwards.
